headline: Coaching Sessions, from entry to detail
overview: Coaching Sessions is your digital log for tracking work with an external coach. After each session, you can record the key strategies discussed, homework assignments to complete before next time, and reflections on your progress. Over time, this creates a searchable history of your coaching journey, helping you stay accountable and see how far you've come.
targetAudience: Users interested in growth tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Coaching Sessions — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the initial state and main interface, with the option to log a new coaching session and a summary of recent sessions.
steps.screenshotAlt: Coaching Sessions landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Log coaching sessions with date, key strategies, and homework assignments
Track completion of homework items between sessions
Searchable history of all past coaching sessions and insights
Reflection prompts to capture what resonated most from each session
tips: Log sessions immediately after they happen while the insights are still fresh
Review past sessions before your next coaching appointment to track progress on homework
